mentions.name: BlogDB
mentions.description: A web project hosted at blogdb.org. It began a couple of years ago as a small proof of concept and was restarted from scratch, serving as a vehicle for the author to work with Claude and learn approaches to coding with AI.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working on https://blogdb.org/ recently.

I originally made it a couple of years ago as a small proof of concept.  A couple of weeks ago I started it over and have been using it as a project to work with Claude and learn approaches to coding with AI.
